title: Resolved image recipe options
description: What `mdux-imagebake` was asked to do: the source image and the pixel format it was decoded to. Describes the **resolved** option set a baker records in `report.json`'s `options`, with every default expanded - not the literal TOML a recipe file carries. ADR-007 decision 4 is why: a silently changed default must not leave every report looking unchanged, so the report records what the bake actually did, and this documents that. Checked against every committed report by tools/docs-lint/check_schema_type_drift.py.

id.description: The artifact id, which names the directory under `generated/image/`.

source.description: Repository-relative path to the source image. QOI, decoded on the host only - no compressed bytes and no decoder reach a device.

sidecar.description: The file the decoded pixels are written to, beside `package.json`.

pixelFormat.description: The format the sidecar holds. One value, and it is in the schema as a closed set rather than as free text so that a second format is a decision somebody makes here.
